purpose: Acquire only the missing causal inputs needed to decide System Admission for EVENT_DRIVEN_CROSS_ASSET_DISLOCATION_V1.

macro_release_ledger.format: append-only JSONL or immutable table export
hard_rules: Only revision_number zero may enter features.
consensus_observed_at_utc must be strictly before scheduled_release_at_utc.
provider_received_at_utc must not be after the decision boundary used by the replay.
Later-revised actuals may be retained for audit but never substitute for first_published_actual_value.
Missing actual, consensus, timestamps, unit, or lineage is never zero and makes the event NOT_EVALUABLE.

cross_asset_event_bars.coverage: Every admitted release must have the last completed pre-release bar and first completed post-release M5 bar for every required confirmation asset.
cross_asset_event_bars.dxy: If synthetic, retain every component bar and the frozen ICE basket formula so the index is reproducible at each event boundary.

fx_execution_bars.format: immutable side-aware completed M1/M5 bars or finer quotes plus manifest
fx_execution_bars.coverage: Entry, every ambiguous stop/target path, maximum hold, and unwind boundary for every admitted event and frozen pair.

cost_margin_unwind_ledger.hard_rule: Missing cost, margin, fill, partial-fill, netting, or unwind evidence is never zero and never sufficient.

forbidden: backfill first-published actual with a later revised value
infer a missing prerelease consensus from a later page
omit spread, adverse half-spread slippage, fee, or financing
select providers, event types, pairs, thresholds, or periods after outcomes
read holdout during acquisition or admission
live, Paper, broker order, deployment, or account mutation
post_acquisition_sequence: verify every raw and normalized hash
if and only if every admission gate passes, freeze split boundaries before outcome calculation
run the 18 preregistered grid points on TRAIN
run independent oracle and byte-identical regeneration
